name: Support & Escalation Console

transitions.provenance: derived — ADM-001 declares entryState.params challengeId, methodId, providerId and ADM-035 holds none of them. The edge carries nothing: providerId only pre-selects (deep link or optional); ADM-001 finds challengeId (createMfaChallenge), methodId (login) itself, and ADM-001 opens on its own
derived — ADM-002 declares entryState.params  and ADM-035 holds none of them. The edge carries nothing: ADM-035 is opened from ADM-002, so this edge is the way back and ADM-002 keeps its own state

notes: Purpose derived from the screen name and its operations on 17 August, not from a requirement.
patternReason: `listSupportNotices` reads a population and nothing reads one of them; the detail is the row until a `get` exists
purpose: Work the support escalations that reach TICVAI, and tell tenants what is known.

components.notes: Declares `publishSupportNotice`. **The gate names what the publish will affect before it happens** — a disabled Publish with no reason is the state operators escalate.

components.label: What publishing changes
components.notes: **Names what goes live, where, and from when.** A publish with no stated consequence is one somebody presses meaning to save.

states.error: Could not load. Names which read failed and leaves the support escalation console untouched.
states.emptyFirstRun: No support escalation console yet. Offers no create action — this screen declares no operation that makes one; distinct from a filter that matched nothing.
states.emptyNoResults: Never shown: `listSupportNotices` takes no filter, so an empty list is always the first-run state above.
states.emptyNoAccess: Shown when the caller lacks `PLATFORM_RELEASE_VIEW`, which `listSupportNotices` requires to show this screen, and names that permission. **Never an empty table** — that reads as *there is no data* and sends somebody to support with the wrong question. A caller who can see the screen but lacks what an action needs sees that action disabled, naming its permission: `PLATFORM_RELEASE_MANAGE` for `publishSupportNotice`.

apisNote: Rebuilt 9 September 2026 from the 2 operations this screen declares, not from a workshop pack — it has none. Columns narrowed on 3 October 2026 to the fields the screen is about (CHG-SPF-002): at most five on a phone or handheld, plumbing and foreign ids left to the record itself.

overlays.body: **Collects what `publishSupportNotice` sends before it is called.** Required: `supportEndsAt`. Optional: `message`, `publishedByPrincipalId`, `scopePath`. **Not asked:** `id` is a client UUIDv7 generated silently; `publishedAt` is set by the server (design-note correction, 2 October 2026). Dismissing sends nothing; the screen behind is unchanged. Not asked, because the server sets it (readOnly in the contract): `affectedTenantIds` (3 October 2026, CHG-SPF-001).

purposeNote: Purpose rewritten 2 October 2026 (CHG-WIR-023): The purpose "Answer a question without needing a person" was copied from a help screen; an escalation console works the escalation queue (design-notes correction platform-foundation ADM-035).

gaps.why: Contract gap recorded 2 October 2026 (CHG-WIR-024): No operation lists or works the support escalations that reach TICVAI.

targetApp.name: TICVAI Control
targetApp.note: **TICVAI operates all five**, whoever signs in. The partner portal, the accreditation intake, the developer portal and the sign-up are outward faces of the control plane, not separate products — but their users are not TICVAI staff, and the permission model has to hold that line. **P17 added 11 September 2026**: a prospect buying TICVAI has no tenant and no cell, so the control plane is the only thing that can serve them.
